primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The diagnostic supports a sustained monsoon rainfall-exposure signal, while the 0/0 image pair contributes no paired-scene change confirmation.

key_values.computed_interpretation: The diagnostic supports a sustained monsoon rainfall-exposure signal, while the 0/0 image pair contributes no paired-scene change confirmation.

criteria.name: Compact final JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns valid JSON with exactly the requested top-level fields, the canonical label, and a score of 5.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct label with minor JSON field issues; award 1 point for a recognizable but incomplete diagnostic.

criteria.name: Duration and window arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes 137 event days, 46 precipitation days, 33.6 percent coverage, and the correct pass states for the two window tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one correct duration plus near-correct coverage; award 1 point for using the right dates but non-inclusive arithmetic.

criteria.name: Rainfall ensemble values
criteria.description: Computes 327.483 mm consensus mean, 7.119 mm/day daily mean, 626.477 mm peak, and 0.863 agreement ratio within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct rainfall values with one formula or rounding error; award 1 point for using only one rainfall product.

criteria.name: Diagnostic test states and score
criteria.description: Marks the five rainfall-duration tests as pass, the image-pair test as fail, and returns the total score of 5.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one wrong pass/fail state with otherwise correct arithmetic; award 1 point for a pass-count idea without the exact diagnostic logic.

criteria.name: Exposure-weighted load
criteria.description: Converts 504,609.262 people to 0.505 million and computes 165.251 mm-million people.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct population conversion or the correct multiplication setup.

criteria.name: Image-pair handling
criteria.description: Reports [0, 0] and treats it as a failed paired-scene confirmation test.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for reporting the counts without connecting them to the failed test.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation without intervention notes
criteria.description: Provides a one-sentence interpretation tied to the diagnostic and avoids added loss totals, closure counts, or intervention notes.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for this item if the answer expands into a broad event narrative or intervention note.

decision_rule.summary: Compute all six threshold tests. The canonical label applies when the five rainfall-duration tests pass and the paired-image test fails.
decision_rule.score_rule: score equals the number of pass states across six tests

provenance.notes: Computed from local event files only; no network access is used.
